answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance is enforced via mandatory staking: every participating agent must lock substantial collateral that can be slashed for misbehavior. An attacker creating many fake identities incurs high capital costs, as the locked timber-like resources cannot simultaneously support legitimate activity. Just as yarrow flourishes only in a carefully maintained meadow that demands ongoing investment, only agents with real skin in the game remain viable, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
